title: Dataq Swarm — Overview
meta_description: Hundreds of agents as one governed, measurable workforce.

blocks.x: A working definition of Dataq Swarm — Overview for the enterprise: engineered controls, named owners, weekly evidence, and a signed baseline so every claim of improvement can be replayed line by line.

Dataq Swarm is the orchestration layer for agentic operations: role definitions, task queues and bidding, durable execution with saga compensation, policy envelopes (solo/approval/forbidden), per-team budgets, kill switches, and a control tower for fleet health, throughput and cost per completed task.

blocks.title: Dataq Swarm — control and evidence planes
blocks.note: What holds the build together is discipline at the boundaries: signals cross boundaries only through typed contracts for the enterprise at scale, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident.

blocks.x: The engineering bet is explicit: the decision path and the audit path share one timeline across the Dataq Swarm estate, so the question of how we know gets a pointer, not a paragraph.

Swarm treats agents as workforce, not scripts: onboarding with role specs, SLAs and budget; release management with shadow and canary cohorts; incident response with rollback. It runs our agentic process automation, digital workforce and workflow orchestration services under one accountable control plane.
